## Flagship Engineering Projects

### 1. SayBill AI (Voice POS & Smart Inventory Ecosystem)
- **URL**: https://junaidas.in/projects/saybill
- **Technologies**: Flutter, Dart, PHP CodeIgniter, Large Language Models (LLMs), WebSockets, Vision Barcode Scanning.
- **Architecture**: Background audio streaming using Dart isolates, sub-420ms round-trip latency, instruction-tuned LLM JSON schema extraction for conversational multilingual speech, automated WhatsApp invoice delivery, and Bluetooth thermal printer integration.
- **Impact**: 98.6% speech parsing accuracy, 70% reduction in retail checkout billing time.

### 2. ERMS (Educational Resource Management System)
- **URL**: https://junaidas.in/projects/erms
- **Technologies**: Python Flask, SQLYOG, MySQL, Bootstrap.
- **Architecture**: Relational database architecture managing thousands of student and course entities, automated reporting engine calculating grade distributions and percentiles in real time.
- **Impact**: Reduced report generation times from days to seconds with zero spreadsheet redundancy.
